key.name: strict
key.summary: Strict mode: no Skip button and no Escape key during a break; the only way out is the countdown (or the watchdog).
key.description: When off (the default) the break overlay carries a Skip button and the Escape key ends the break early. The overlay is a modal wall either way: every keybinding is still refused and input is still grabbed. Read when a break starts, so a change applies from the next break.

key.name: mini-interval
key.description: Minutes of work between one break and the next.

key.name: mini-duration
key.description: How long a mini break lasts, in seconds.

key.name: long-duration
key.description: How long a long break lasts, in seconds.

key.name: minis-per-long
key.description: Number of mini breaks between two long breaks. 0 means every break is long; 1 alternates mini and long.

key.name: mini-warning
key.description: Seconds of notice before a mini break starts. 0 disables the warning.

key.name: long-warning
key.description: Seconds of notice before a long break starts. 0 disables the warning.

key.name: mini-postpone
key.description: Minutes a mini break is pushed back when postponed. 0 disables postponing mini breaks.

key.name: long-postpone
key.description: Minutes a long break is pushed back when postponed. 0 disables postponing long breaks.

key.name: postpone-window
key.description: Percentage of the break during which the postpone button is offered.

key.name: idle-reset
key.description: Minutes away from the machine (idle, locked or suspended) that count as a break and restart the cycle.

key.name: morning-hour
key.summary: Morning hour for "pause until tomorrow" (hour, local time)
key.description: Local-time hour at which a "pause until tomorrow" ends.

key.name: overlay-color
key.description: Background colour of the break overlay, as a CSS hex string.

key.name: overlay-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the break overlay background.

key.name: end-sound
key.summary: Sound played at the end of a break (file path)
key.description: A relative name is resolved against the extension's assets directory; an absolute path is used verbatim; an empty string means silence.

key.name: first-run-done
key.summary: Whether the first-run notice has been shown
key.description: Set to true once the notification explaining what a break does — and, in strict mode, that it cannot be skipped and how to recover a wedged session — has been shown. Set it back to false to see that notice again.

key.name: breaks-enabled
key.description: When off, no breaks are scheduled. Toggled from the panel menu and persisted across Shell restarts.

key.name: watched-calendars
key.summary: EDS source uids of watched calendars; their timed events pause breaks
key.description: Evolution Data Server calendar source uids, ticked in the preferences. While a timed event from one of these calendars is in progress, and for a short lead shadow before it (the next break's warning and duration plus 60 seconds), no break starts; an event in progress also ends a running break. All-day, cancelled and free (transparent) events never count. Uids of calendars that no longer exist are ignored.
